title: The Patient House
author: Odile Whitlock
blurb: Edmund Coldharbour, a hospice nurse who hears the dying count backwards, doesn't believe, has never believed, will not begin believing now. Then all the photographs from grandma's house now include an extra chair — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must finish the ritual the founders started, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
